content: OBS browser-source overlays are typically a transparent HTML/JS page (added as an OBS Browser Source, no window chrome) that opens its own websocket connection to a lightweight relay/overlay server; a separate controller path pushes state updates which the server broadcasts to all connected overlay clients on the same channel/room, enabling multiple concurrently-open overlay instances (or floors) fed from one state source. CSS animations drive the actual visual alerts/movement.
